_comment: Status taxonomy mapped to GHL pipeline stages. Source of truth for cross-app status display + GHL sync. Imported from the GHL Blinker Configuration spreadsheet's `status` tab. Working draft.
_principle: Blinker DB + PostHog have FINE granularity (every step). GHL has COARSE stages (groupings). Multiple platform_status values can map to one crm_stage.

Empty.description: A new application was started, however the vehicle and customer information was not complete enough to generate a quote.

Quoted.description: Agent entered vehicle and customer info to generate quotes; product package created with default plan selected.

Quoted - No Results.description: Sub-status of Quoted. No plans returned.

Selected.description: Agent reviewed, saved, and selected protection plan quote(s); consumer sent package for review.

Sent to Consumer.description: Agent sent consumer agreement and payment workflow.

Consumer Reviewed.description: Consumer clicked on the link and visited the coverage / payment / price page.

Booked.description: Customer confirmed selected plan. Awaiting signature and billing information.

Remitted - Product Error.description: Sub-status of Remitted: error remitting to Product Provider.

Remitted - Payment Error.description: Sub-status of Remitted: error remitting to Payment Provider.

Remitted - Both Error.description: Sub-status of Remitted: errors at both providers.

Remitted.description: System has remitted the agreement to the provider for activation.

Active.description: Consumer making payments with active agreement.

Paid in Full.description: Consumer paid in full or completed all payments.

Pending Cancellation.description: Recurring payment failed; pending cancellation if not corrected.

insurance._id_principle: Each status has a `machine_id` (Blinker's internal canonical ID, lowercase dotted) and `external_event` (the actual Embedded Insurance webhook event name, where applicable). Human label remains the source of truth for display; machine_id is for app code and PostHog event names.
insurance._signal_source_principle: Each status has a `signal_source` declaring what triggers a transition INTO it. Values: `partner` (Embedded Insurance fires a webhook), `blinker_internal` (Blinker-side telemetry, e.g. URL-shortener click events), `agent_action` (agent UI action like 'Send link'), `consumer_action` (consumer UI action like form submit), `system` (Blinker backend automation, e.g. scheduled job). This makes explicit what was previously implicit (external_event: null no longer requires inference). Code that subscribes to webhook streams should filter to `signal_source: 'partner'`; agent/consumer-driven UIs use the appropriate source.
insurance._actor_principle: Each status has an `actor` (`agent` | `consumer` | `system`) declaring WHO, in human terms, caused the step — distinct from `signal_source` (which SYSTEM reported it) and `role` (persona visibility). Added v3.0.15 (ADR 27 D6) for the CoPilot left-rail timeline's per-step actor badge. The insurance EI flow is deterministic, so the actor is a static per-status property: agent originates + sends the link; consumer opens/captures/views/binds on EI's microsite; system handles backend cascade + error states. Protection/refi have no machine_id taxonomy — their timeline actor comes from the `step_change` activity `source` field instead (ADR 27 D7).

_insurance_flow_paths._principle: An insurance lead-origination request is one of two flow paths chosen at link-generation time. flowPath determines which EI endpoint the lead link is generated against and which webhook sequence we expect.

values.capture_and_quote: Two-phase: EI runs verification (capture of existing policy via id-card or third-party lookup), then attempts a quote against the verified policy. Webhook sequence: verification.completed → quote.completed (or error). Used when the consumer has an existing policy and we want to surface savings vs current carrier.
values.quote_only: Single-phase: EI quotes against vehicle + applicant data without prior policy verification. No verification.completed event. Used when no prior policy exists or verification would add friction without value.

Started.description: User starts the insurance referral workflow. Note: crm_stage is intentionally null — pre-pipeline state, no GHL stage. Code that buckets statuses by crm_stage must handle null explicitly (skip from pipeline displays, or surface as 'pre-lead').

New Lead.description: Lead shared with insurance partner via integration/transfer (partner ack returns synchronously; we surface this as our internal 'created' state).

Error - Verification.description: Lead/verification-phase failure. EI fires a single `error` event (not phase-specific); adapter discriminates by summary contents — if summary is empty OR contains insuranceVerification but no quote, this is verification-stage. Stays as a Blinker-internal machine_id for taxonomy clarity even though the partner event is shared with error.quote.

Error - Quote.description: Quote-phase failure: verification succeeded, partner could not return a quote (rate-table miss, eligibility decline). EI fires the same `error` event as error.verification; adapter discriminates by summary.quote being present. See `_insurance_error_disambiguation` block in this file's _principles.

Duplicate.description: Duplicate lead identified by partner. NOTE: EI's documented webhook contract does not include a separate 'duplicate' status — duplicates may be returned synchronously as a 4xx on POST /auto/v1/leads (per Postman docs: '4xx range indicate an error that failed given the information provided e.g duplicate lead received'). Phase 1 mock surfaces it as a webhook for demo coherence; real adapter handles the 4xx path. Flagged for canon TODO.

Capture Link Sent.description: Email/SMS sent to contact for insurance capture.

Quote Link Sent.description: Email/SMS sent to contact for insurance quote.

Capture Link Viewed.description: Email/SMS link followed by contact for insurance capture. Source: Blinker URL-shortener telemetry, not partner.

Quote Link Viewed.description: Email/SMS link followed by contact for insurance quote. Source: Blinker URL-shortener telemetry, not partner.

Capture Completed.description: Insurance verification completed by EI. Webhook event: `lead_summary` with `status: verification.completed`. The summary.insuranceVerification block contains policyInfo (carrier, policyType, policyNumber, vehicles, namedInsureds), media (insurance card image URLs with expiresAt), and source ('id-card' | 'third-party'). We rename 'verification' → 'capture' at our boundary because the human-facing concept is capture; the partner concept is verification (they're verifying the consumer's existing policy).

Quoted.description: Quote successfully generated by EI. Webhook event: `lead_summary` with `status: quote.completed`. summary.quote contains: id, status: 'completed', carrier, totalPremiumCents, optional savingsAmountCents, createdAt. May also include summary.insuranceVerification if verification ran first (Capture+Quote path).

Quote Viewed.description: Consumer viewed the quote on EI's microsite. Webhook event: `lead_summary` with `status: quote.viewed`. EI hosts the quote screen and fires this themselves — Blinker has no role in detecting the view. Note: a previous canon revision (2026-05-02-insurance-quote-flow-cleanup) wrongly flipped this to `consumer_action` based on an incorrect assumption that Blinker would host the quote screen. Reverted in 2026-05-03-ei-real-contract.

Policy Written.description: Consumer purchased the policy on EI's microsite; partner confirmed binding. Webhook event: `lead_summary` with `status: policy.bound`. summary.policy contains: id, carrier, boundAt. Note: a previous canon revision (2026-05-02-insurance-quote-flow-cleanup) introduced a `policy.requested` status to track consumer click intent — that status has been removed in 2026-05-03-ei-real-contract because the consumer never touches Blinker for the bind action; the click happens on EI's microsite and is not separately reported.
